Distribution. Philippines: Luzon, Palaui, Babuyan and Camiguin islands (Fig. 12).

Manila is a capital city of Philippines at Metro Manila Province but Manila (or Manilla, Manille etc.) can mean the whole Luzon Island or Philippines on old labels. There is Mount Makiling at the border between Laguna and Batangas Provinces. Therefore, specimens localised only Mt. Makiling without specification of Province cannot be assigned to a province. Specimens with locality data Palawan (2 ♀♀), Mindanao (4 ♀♀) and Fidji (1 ♀) are probably erroneously localised and therefore they are not listed in examined material. Lander (2003) also mentioned distribution on Batan and Romblon islands but I have never studied specimens from these islands.
